jobs.title: Software Developer - Contract
jobs.description:

6. b. Knowledge of database encryption and handle on sensitive data.

a. Implementation or conceptual knowledge of cloud architectures includes understanding onload balances, relationships between endpoints, private link, DNS,domain knowledge,firewall.

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
jobs.description:
About Us
  
  
Innovate. Create. Elevate.
  
  
At Vertis, we believe innovation starts with people. We design and deliver exceptional digital solutions that elevate our clients' brands and the experiences they create for their customers. Through technology-driven creativity, we enable meaningful business transformation. Our team is made up of capable, confident, and motivated individuals who collaborate, challenge ideas, and grow together.
  
  
About the job
  
  
We are seeking a talented Full Stack Developer with expertise in Node.js and/or .NET, along with proficiency in modern front-end frameworks (React, Angular, or Vue.js), REST APIs, and cloud environments. As a Full Stack Developer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying robust web applications that leverage cloud services.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Develop and maintain backend services using Node.js and/or .NET, ensuring scalability, performance, and security.
  
  
Design and implement responsive, intuitive front-end interfaces using React, Angular, or Vue.js.
  
  
Integrate backend services with front-end interfaces through RESTful APIs.
  
  
Deploy applications to cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
  
  
Optimize applications for performance, scalability, and cost-effectiveness in cloud environments.
  
  
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and deliver new features and enhancements.
  
  
Conduct code reviews, ensuring code quality, adherence to best practices, and scalability.
  
  
Troubleshoot and debug issues across the full stack, from frontend to backend.
  
  
Stay updated on emerging technologies, industry trends, and best practices in cloud development.
  
  
Requirements and Qualifications
  
  
4 years+ of experience as a Full Stack Developer or in a similar role.
  
  
Strong proficiency in Node.js and/or .NET and their respective ecosystems.
  
  
Experience with at least one modern front-end framework (React, Svelte, Angular, or Vue.js).
  
  
Solid understanding of RESTful API design and services development.
  
  
Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform is a plus.
  
  
Familiarity with containerization and orchestration tools (Docker, Kubernetes) is a plus.
  
  
Knowledge of database systems such as MongoDB, MySQL, SQL Server, or PostgreSQL.
  
  
Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.
  
  
Ability to work independently and as part of a team in an agile environment.
  
  
Experience with version control systems such as Git.
  
  
Benefits
  
  
Competitive compensation
  
  
Medical & Dental benefits
  
  
International and multicultural working environment
  
  
Training and development opportunities
  
  
Career growth in a fast-growing organisation
  
  
Birthday Leave
  
  
Our Hiring Process
  
  
After submitting your application, our Talent Acquisition team will review your profile. If your skills and experience align with the role, we'll get in touch to discuss the next steps. Please be cautious of recruitment fraud; only engage with emails from our official team that end with @vertis.digital domain.
  
  
Vertis is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that diversity of thought, background, and experience drives innovation and success. That's why we are committed to building and nurturing a team that reflects a wide range of perspectives, abilities, identities, and experiences. At Vertis, every voice matters, and together, we achieve more. We appreciate all applications; however,
  
  
only shortlisted candidates will be contacted
  
  
. Thank you for your interest.
  
  
The use of artificial intelligence tools, including language models such as ChatGPT, during the interview process is strictly prohibited and will result in the disqualification of your application.
  
  
Singapore Citizens are welcome to apply. This position is supported by IMDA's Company-Led Training Programme.
  
  
We’re a group of creative thinkers that blend the knowledge across multiple disciplines to create new experiences or products that meet end user and organizational needs.
  
  
Vertis Digital was establised to help organisation realise the true value of a digital transformation.
  
  
We help organsation unleash their team's full potential and delivery powerful and meaning Digital Experiences for their customers.

jobs.title: Consultor Tecnológico .Net, hibrido
jobs.description:
Consultor Tecnológico .Net
  
Desde CMV Consultores gestionamos una oportunidad para incorporarse a una consultora tecnológica especializada en soluciones de Gestión de Personas, con más de 18 años de trayectoria.
  
  
**Formato de trabajo híbrido:** 2 días oficina en Madrid o Barcelona y 3 días de teletrabajo, lunes y viernes siempre es teletrabajo.
  
**Horario de trabajo:** De lunes a jueves entrada flexible entre las 8:00 y las 10:00 y salida entre las 17:00 y las 19:00, con una jornada de 8,5 horas. Viernes: de 8:00 a 15:00.
  
  
¿Qué harás?
  
**Análisis y diseño:** Analizar las necesidades de los clientes, diseñar soluciones e integraciones y elaborar la documentación funcional y técnica.
  
**Desarrollo y soporte:** Participar en el desarrollo de software a medida, del mantenimiento evolutivo y correctivo, la resolución de incidencias y mejora de aplicaciones existentes.
  
**Diseño de soluciones:** Transformar las necesidades del cliente en soluciones tecnológicas eficientes, escalables y adaptadas a los requisitos del proyecto.
  
**Integración y calidad:** Diseñar y ejecutar pruebas funcionales y de integración, garantizando el correcto funcionamiento, estabilidad e integridad de las soluciones.
  
**Mejora continua:** Analizar los cambios y su impacto, evaluar alternativas técnicas y proponer mejoras para optimizar la eficiencia, calidad y mantenibilidad de los sistemas.
  
  
¿Qué buscamos?
  
Experiencia en desarrollo backend sobre tecnología .NET (Visual Studio, .NET Framework, C#, ASP.NET, WPF).
  
Más de 2 años de experiencia en análisis técnicos sobre tecnología .Net.
  
Más de 2 años de experiencia en gestor de versiones gitHub.
  
  
**Otros aspectos que valoramos:**  
Se valorará conocimiento de soluciones y herramientas tecnológicas aplicadas a RRHH.
  
Experiencia en el Desarrollo end-to-end de aplicaciones desarrolladas en tecnología .NET.
  
Experiencia en .NET core.
  
Conocimiento en metodotología sobre desarrollo seguro.
  
Conocimientos en gestión de proyectos tecnológicos.
  
Buen nivel de inglés
  
  
Visual Studio, .Net Framework, C#, Asp.Net, WPF, gitHub

jobs.title: Sitecore Engineer
jobs.description:
Wat je zal doen

Ben jij een Sitecore expert of een .NET Developer met Sitecore ervaring die méér wil dan standaard projecten? Zoek je een plek waar je wordt uitgedaagd, werkt met de nieuwste technologieën en waar jouw ideeën écht impact maken? Dan is dit jouw kans om als Sitecore Engineer bij iO aan de slag te gaan!

Bij iO bouw je digitale platformen
die er echt toe doen. Geen kleine projecten, maar complexe, high-traffic omgevingen voor klanten als De Goudse Verzekeringen, Alliander, Husqvarna
. Hier draait het niet alleen om code kloppen – je bent inhoudelijk betrokken
bij architectuurkeuzes, systeemintegraties en de volledige optimalisatie van de gebruikerservaring.

Jij krijgt de vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid om in teamverband maar ook zelfstandig te werken met de nieuwste Sitecore XM Cloud en Composable DXP-oplossingen, zoals Content Hub en Sitecore Search
. Je werkt niet alleen aan de technische realisatie, maar denkt ook strategisch
mee over hoe we digitale ervaringen naar het volgende niveau tillen.

Bij iO krijg je bovendien volledige controle
over het Sitecore-platform
van je klanten: s oftware development, continuous delivery én cloud-infrastructuur
vallen onder jouw team. Zo bouw je stabiele, schaalbare en future-proof oplossingen
die écht impact maken.

En dat betekent:

✔ Werken met de nieuwste tech
– Sitecore XM Cloud, Composable DXP en .NET-architecturen.

✔ Uitdagende projecten
– voor merken met miljoenen gebruikers per maand.

✔ Een actieve Sitecore Expert Group
– kennisdeling via meetups, conferenties en User Groups.

✔ DevOps mindset
– automatisering en continuous delivery als standaard.

✔ Persoonlijke groei
– een cultuur waarin je samenwerkt met experts en altijd blijft leren. Persoonlijke groei staat dan ook altijd voorop, je krijgt voldoende ruimte om te groeien en krijgt daar uiteraard een ontwikkelbudget bij.

Wil jij bouwen aan complexe, innovatieve platformen en meedenken over de digitale strategie van grote merken? Solliciteer nu en ontdek wat iO voor jou in petto heeft! 🚀

jobs.title: Backend Staff Engineer
jobs.description:
Backend Staff Engineer – Help us build the next generation of Priva solutions

About Priva | Your Future Ecosystem

Located between Rotterdam and The Hague, in the heart of the world’s leading greenhouse region, lies Westland, home to Priva’s modern campus in De Lier. This innovative region has been the foundation of our family-owned company since the 1950s.

What started as a hardware business has grown into a global leader in horticulture and building automation. Today, Priva develops advanced hardware, software, and digital services for climate control, energy efficiency, and water optimization. Our solutions support horticulture, indoor and city farming, as well as offices, hotels, hospitals, and retail environments worldwide.
Our next ambition? Becoming a leading digital service provider with “Climate as a Service” solutions that help customers operate more sustainably.

With over 600 colleagues, 16 international offices, and more than 400 installation partners, we deliver smart, sustainable solutions in over 100 countries. If you want your work to have impact on sustainability, food security, and the way cities grow, then this is where you belong.

Why this role matters

At Priva, we are building the next generation of building automation systems: cloud-connected, security-first, and designed for long-term reliability. You will work on an innovative IoT platform that combines embedded controllers, edge gateways, and cloud services to keep buildings running safely for 10–15 years with minimal maintenance.

As a Backend Staff Engineer
, you will play a key role in shaping the architecture, reliability, and long-term maintainability of our cloud-connected backend platform.

You will use your deep technical expertise to help us build resilient, observable, and scalable backend solutions. You will guide technical direction, support teams in making sound architectural decisions, and raise the engineering standard across backend development.
This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who loves the challenge of combining hands-on engineering with system-level thinking, technical leadership, and a strong focus on reliability.

Your team

You will join Team Amazey, a team of experienced frontend, backend and QA Engineers, responsible for all cloud services related to Nuro Creator web application. Since the product is nearing launch, it is all hands on board to make this happen: getting features to users, continuous improving SW quality in ways that are helpful for ourselves all whilst maintaining integrity of the users projects when migrations are required.

What you’ll do

Translate product and system requirements into scalable backend designs
Lead the design and development of backend services using C# 12 and .NET 8
Define backend architecture for cloud-connected products
Review critical technical designs and code, especially in areas that affect reliability, security, scalability, or maintainability
Design solutions with a focus on high availability, resilience and long-term maintainability
Guide teams on distributed-system concerns
Collaborate closely with our internal and external teams including hardware, firmware and QA
Improve engineering practices around deployment and monitoring
Support root-cause analysis and drive durable corrective actions after production issues
Mentor engineers and help raise the technical maturity of the backend engineering organization
Make pragmatic technical trade-offs between speed, quality, cost, risk, and long-term maintainability.

What you bring

We are looking for an experienced engineer with strong technical leadership capabilities and a system-level mindset. Furthermore, we will look for:
Extensive experience building backend systems using C# and .NET
Proven experience designing, building, and operating distributed systems in production
Practical experience with Akka.NET and actor-based architectures
Strong understanding of cloud-native architecture on Microsoft Azure
Experience with event-driven systems, message queues, background processing, and distributed workflows
Strong knowledge of API design, versioning, authentication, and authorization
Experience with relational and NoSQL databases such as Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, Cosmos DB, Redis, or similar technologies
Good understanding of observability, including structured logging, metrics, distributed tracing, alerting and dashboards
Experience with CI/CD, infrastructure as code, deployment automation, and production operations
Strong engineering judgment and the ability to simplify complex technical problems
The ability to influence technical decisions across teams without relying on formal authority
A strong focus on reliability, maintainability, security, and operational excellence
Clear communication skills and the ability to explain technical trade-offs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
A mentoring mindset and a desire to help other engineers grow
Strong debugging and problem-solving skills at both code and system level

Nice to have experience with:
Cloud-connected embedded products, IoT systems, building automation, industrial systems, energy systems, or similar high-reliability environments.
Azure IoT Hub, Device Provisioning Service, Digital Twins, MQTT, or edge-to-cloud architectures
Event sourcing, CQRS, domain-driven design, or stateful distributed systems
Docker or Bicep
OpenTelemetry, Application Insights, Azure Monitor, or similar observability platforms
Security-by-design practices, including identity, secrets management, secure communication, and least-privilege access.
Reliability engineering practices such as failure-mode analysis, chaos testing, operational readiness reviews, and post-incident learning
Products with long lifecycles, high uptime expectations, and low maintenance requirements

What You Get

In Numbers
Competitive salary and benefits package for senior engineers
Flexible working hours and 30 vacation days, with the option to buy more
8% holiday allowance
Travel allowance of €0.23/km (max. 150 km per day)

For Your Well-Being and Growth
Solid pension plan and participation scheme
Personal development budget and training opportunities
Healthy cafeteria
Free on-site gym with CrossFit, Pilates, Spinning, table tennis, and table football

Our Culture and values

At Priva, our mission is to create environments where people can work, grow, and thrive. We deliver sustainable solutions for horticulture and building automation that reduce resource consumption and contribute to global sustainability goals.
Our culture is built on four core values: Sustainable, Innovative, Make it Happen, and Human.
Colleagues describe Priva as open, ambitious, innovative, friendly, and down-to-earth. We offer a flat, informal, and fast-paced environment where you are encouraged to take ownership and grow.
We believe diversity drives success. We welcome people from all backgrounds and perspectives and create a workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to be their authentic self.

Ready to join us?

Talk is cheap, and action gives you confidence. Sound good? Feel free to contact one of our recruiters.
